name: engineering-conventions
description: Engineering conventions for projects built to run in production. Terraform and AWS infrastructure, and Go and Node.js AWS Lambdas: Terraform file organisation, tagging and resource naming, S3/CloudFront hosting, Route 53/SES, Cognito and WAF; trigger-based directory naming, module and package layout, structured JSON logging, failure handling and idempotency, OpenTelemetry metrics for CloudWatch Omni, tracing and alarms, CI-built reproducible arm64 artifacts, dependency hygiene, and unit and integration testing.
